Messages.Body:
LSJ recently posted on the White Wolf forum some very fascinating information
concerning what happens to VTES After Gehenna. Haven't seen a repost on the
newsgroup yet so I thought I'd copy the information for those who don't
frequent the White Wolf forum much:

Subject: V:TES A.G.
LSJ - 12/02/2003 14:27:13 - vte...@white-wolf.com

We haven't yet decided the nature of the first expansion after Gehenna (Gehenna
is due out in May 2004).

Any suggestions (that remain in the present time)?

Some possible ideas:

An expansion centered around allies and equipment (boys and their toys).
Kindred of the Ebony Kingdom <City> by Night - e.g., Paris by Night or Berlin
by Night. Other

Feel free to post here, but for real counting, email me directly at
vte...@white-wolf.com with the subject "V:TES A.G."

Thanks,
Scott

Enjoy!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
In message <3FCDEA82...@duke.edu>,
David Cherryholmes <david.che...@duke.edu> mumbled something
about:

>I wonder if this was simply a random oversite, or if it signals a shift
>in attention away from the newsgroup and towards the forums? Certainly
>a petition for input on the content of the next expansion seems
>important to me. Personally, I don't frequent the forums, nor do I
>think the level of expertise is as high there as it is here, but I could
>be wrong about that.

The forums are representative of a different type of V:TES player, in
general. There was a while when I read both, and made an effort to
respond to both of them; I no longer have anywhere NEAR that amount of
free time available, so I do well just to occasionally catch up here.

The newsgroup has all of the tactical and technical experts; the people
who enjoy the game itself, but are primarily quite good at the "how to
win" portion. Most of the multi-rush deck ideas, for example, have come
from miscellaneous discussions here on r.g.t-c.j -- this is a relatively
recent archetype in comparison to Days of Yore. It is also the home of
the Dog Poo: the Eternal Struggle contingent; those who would play the
game no matter what the art and names were, because the quality of the
game itself is so rich.

The webforums lean much more towards the people who are primarily
playing for the flavor of the game, and/or people who are involved in
the World of Darkness in some other fashion... or people who play mostly
in their local playgroups, and are just now discovering that there is a
whole worldwide community of V:TES players. They are generally very up
on WoD issues and the like, and much more likely to be aware of the
backstory behind things than your average USENETtizen. The technical
expertise is significantly less, however; you will frequently see issues
thrown back and forth constantly that were hashed out on the newsgroup
years ago, with almost the exact same arguments being brought up for and
against, and the "malk stealth bleed is cheesy!!" post still shows up
there pretty frequently.

As such, I'm not surprised that the request for ideas went out to the
webforum. They're much more likely to HAVE an opinion on what they'd
like to see; the DP:TES contingent doesn't really care which way the
direction goes as long as new strategy options and cards keep coming. I
know I personally couldn't care less what the theme of the next
expansion is.

-- Derek

Messages.Author: Daniel Figueiredo
Messages.Body:
halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote in message news:<20031202231446...@mb-m16.aol.com>...


Hi. Just want to add my opinion to the topic.

A whole expansion centering on allies and equipment seems a bit too
much. They seem better suited to being part of whatever expansion ets
released. like, if it is a City expanison, make the allies and
equipment the Kindred of said city or region would most likely rely
upon. I love allies and equipment though, so nothing against a whole
expansion on them, it just feels like kind of a lacking theme for a
whole expansion.

The City expansions would be nice, only a lot of the by night books
have already been explored. With the exception of Cairo by Night, most
other by nights have had at least 50% or so of their vampires
released, sometimes more, like the Mexico kindred. So instead of
having City expansions, we could have bigger regions, like whole
countries or even continents. South America and Africa are the most
unexplored. A South American expansion would be very nice, and I
volunteer to help WW with any questions they might have about ideas
for cards, the general feel of such expansion and whatever.

The Kindred of the Ebony Kingdom would also be a great choice, and
fill the need for an African Expansion. Not all of you may know, but
the African "clans" are the same clans we already have, only they call
themselves other names and some have different dicsipline spreads,
like the Nosferatu having Presence instead of Animalism I think. So
they wouldn´t be like having new bloodlines, but at the same time
would be a bit different from the existing clans. And almost all of
them are represented, there just aren´t any African variety of
Malkavians, Ventrue Tremere and Giovanni, but they do have surviving
lines of Salubri and Cappadocians. And the Followers of Set from
Africa are 100% like their non-sub-saharan counterparts. The Assmaites
are mainly of the Sorcerer variety, so their disciplines are
Obfuscate, Quietus and Assamite Sorcery. And the coolest part is that,
since there are no African Giovanni, Tremere, Malkavians or Ventrue,
the only local "clan" with Dominate are the Lasombra, who use their
almost exclusive control of the dicsipline there very efficiently.

Another idea that would be nice and 90% of the people who bother to
express their opinions seem to really want is another bloodlines
expansion. I do think that it should NOT be the first expansion after
Gehhena though. A region specific expansion, that would be the size of
a basic set seems nicer. And whatever expansion that gets made, it
should adress the Independents and their current state of inferiority.

So basically, I would vote for:

1)A Regional expansion, Africa or South America. Any other regions are
somewhat covered already or do not have enough Kindred to merit that
(like China and the east in general). This expansion could also be
BIG, a new basic expansion, since the Camarilla Edition will be kind
of old by the time this new one (at least the middle of 2005 by what
the people at WW are saying). A new basic expansion will PROBABLY mean
the dawn of group 4, which is something not all of us are looking
forward to, but if it must come, it must come.

2)A Bloodlines 2 expansion. With the same 12 bloodlines introduced in
the first. WW seems adverse to more bloodlines cards, and I frankly do
not know why. I also think that since they have not had any real
support since their release, save them for this new Bloodlines 2
expansion whenever it comes, and have their vampires all be group 4 if
that is the only way they will do it. The dicsipline and clan cards
would be useable, and having the new vamps be group 4 will not cause
any balance issues, or take away the original intent that bloodlines
are not supposed to have whole crypts based on them.

3)A new expansion for the Independents, a la Final Nights. Maybe this
won´t get done as the first expansion after Gehenna since the
independent group 3 vampires are still mostly inexistent. But after
Gehenna (which I think will have new vampires for all clans, not
bloodlines) and a new regional and or basic expansion, they could
safely make a new Independent expansion, since they could be able to
introduce group 4 by then. I would personally very much lie a new
Independent expansion before a new Bbloodlines expansion.

Daniel.

I don't get to rant often enough about how bad Unglued was. CCG parodies are
easy. Think Yu-Gi-Oh!, Dungeon Dice Monsters. Magic has had at least two
serious parody attempts and both sucked. Have to involve a bit of wit into
parody; the ideal is to not be sure whether design was serious or not. The
only useful thing Unglued did for Magic was introduce those creature token
cards.

Maybe, someday, I'll get around to following the instructions and sending off
what I want to see to LSJ directly. To avoid endless procrastination on
offering a thought I've had for quite some time, basically what I'd like to see
are new disciplines and new clans first, then help for sucky disciplines and
sucky clans. I figure the latter is more likely, but it can't hurt to mention
the former.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
What about Cults and Coteries?

Groups of secret societies, their members, some of their 'stuff'
(locations, resources, , retainers/allies, etc). With neat interacting
negligable specials on members of the societies.
eg: Jim and Ben are both in some little cult called Eat Old vampires,
or something.
Their card names might be Jim, initiate of Eat Old Vampires.
Ben, Leader of Eat Old Vampires.
(and you could introduce some group 1 vampires of the Cold Dawn, who
have specials if Dre is in play or does stuff)
Ben could have a special: If Jim diablerises an older vampire, Ben
gains a blood.

Like we have now with Edith and Enid, but more widespread.

Maybe add Hank and Bubba to the Eat Old vampires cult.
Jim's special: If Hank puts an older vampire into torpor in combat,
Jim untaps.
Hank's special: If Bubba blocks an older vampire, Hank may tap to
enter combat with the acting vampire after combat (if any) if you do
not control the acting vampire.
Bubba's special: Ben may move a blood to Bubba during any methuselah's
untap phase.

their clans could be all over the place, but with a thread of shared
disciplines through them (perhaps pair-wise contiguous, or something).

You could have a master card, Where Tubby Lives. put it in play, once
during your turn, one of Ben, Jim, Hank, or Bubba that you control may
enter combat with an older vampire controlled my another methuselah as
a D action.

moving away from the Eat Old Vampires cult, you could have other
useful culty stuff.

The Cult of Stuff
Unique Master.
Put this card in play (very important text, designers take note!).
During your untap phase you may put a Stuff counter on a minion you
control. Tap to allow a minion you control with a Stuff counter to put
a Stuff counter on a minion controlled by another methuselah as a D
action. A minion with a stuff counter may not block a minion with a
stuf counter. Burn this card and all stuff counters when the oldest
ready vampire with a Stuff counter is burned or goes to torpor.

right, so now i'm laying out text when i only wanted to lay out ideas.

trying to get back to the ideas level: Cults that you can spread among
other methuselahs minions, undermining their control (like above!),
and groups of vampires who explicitly synergise well together, but in
relatively minor ways.

> how about a inconnu expansion,that would really cool for vtes
>

Totally agreed. This would be a very cool "small" expansion (à la Black Hand
/ Anarchs), with new (BIG !) vampires, special mechanics etc. With a
different name, like Conspiracis of Darkness, it could also include some
allies societies (Society of Leopold, Technocracy, Orphic circle... ;)

> > An expansion centered around allies and equipment (boys and their toys).
> > Kindred of the Ebony Kingdom <City> by Night - e.g., Paris by Night or
> Berlin
> > by Night.
>

> ah ah. Finally, we will see loads of french vampires with baguettes and
> berets. And all the possible variations of Kamel's face (Kamel drunk,
Kamel
> sober and dealing to get his VP, Kamel breaking a deal). And don't forget
> the frogs :)

MEGA-LOL !! I also have a picture of Dancing Kamel...

Seriously, though : regional expansions would be nice, although I'm not sure
how they could be handled ; what would they bring besides "just" new
vampires and new cards ? I mean, although I'm far from a fan of Anarch, or
even Black Hand mechanics, and although I love Bloodlines the special
mechanics are mostly far from perfect, the possibility of having new, unique
gaming opportunities is in itself interesting, as it renews the game. If the
struggle must be centered around a city, then for me this should change the
game, and having tried it in league format maybe there should be a new way
of winning by possessing a certain number of city locations (that you could
place on a map ?), or getting the most important titles in the city : this I
would really like, although of course it would mean that the players agree
on playing this variant in the first place ; but then, it could work, and
would IMHO bring a refreshing variation to the game.

> > An expansion centered around allies and equipment (boys and their toys).
> > Kindred of the Ebony Kingdom

The RPG expansion looks great, but I'm not sure it would fit VTES well...
And there are no Giovanni !!! ;-)

There is a real need for boosting up the indies ; but then, if this has to
be a Group 4 expansion, I won't buy it, just trade some good cards in (not
being compatible with the quasi totality of existing indies looks like a
major obstacle to me).

I don't think there should be (yet) a Bloodlines 2, although I'd like to see
a few more Bloodlines cards here and there (in a new "Misfits" expansion,
which could cover the "rebels" someone talked about, plus some indies, plus
Kindred Most Wanted or what-have-you ?)...

And of course, the Allies thing I'm a big fan of : it could go on and on and
on without new grouping and without shifting game balance between groups (or
allowing for too many vampires with the same out-of-clan disciplines) :
Garous, Mages, Wraiths / Orpheus, Hunters, played as main characters and not
just mere allies (as the Gargoyles...), but still included in the vampire
setting (and balanced for it, contrarily to the RGP. Garous would of course
be great fighters, but would have to be able to kick winnies out but have
trouble with elder vampires (first it would fit the background, second it
couldn't be bad for the game...) ; Mages would offer many fearsome
possibilities, although they would need some kind of weakness (in life
counters or what damage does to them compared to vampires, maybe ?) ; and of
course Necromancy would be what wraiths fear the most (like Dominate for the
rest of "us"). Hunters I don't know much but I guess it could be intersting,
and hopefully not just for the fight (although I certainly don't see them as
big bleeders). Vampires would remain the main voters, though, maybe the only
ones with that possibility : their main advantage upon all the rest, from
what I know, is their thorough control of the mortal world !

So my main wishes would be :

1) Cities with new district mechanics)
2) Allies
3) Inconnu
4) Dark Ages, although not mentionned above
5) Rebels
6) Ebony Kingdom

And of course, we still have the possibility of considering the game after
Ravnos (not dead of course, it's all an illusion...) decides that the whole
universe becomes a paper (RPG and card) game : new characters would be
"Correct" LSJ, "Flaming" Derek, Jeff "I made all the decks before you"
Thompson, etc. ;)

Or, in french version :
"Jumping" Reyda, "I didn't rape your sister (yet)" Nagaraja, "Play as I want
or don't play" Kamel, "Insane necromancer" Orpheus, François "Funniest
Poster Ever" Gombault, Stéphane "I'm the best but don't say it too loud"
Lavrut, etc... ;))

We DON'T want to see that, do we ?

For the rest, I was quite serious...

Orpheus
